question: On the historical 360-contract cohort, does a volatility contraction inside the prior 12H bar predict a sustained expansion in the V1.7 cloud direction?
single_variable: Compare a breakout of an inside 12H candle with the same setup restricted to a candle whose high-low range is the smallest of its last seven full 12H candles, including itself. Each version takes its own first eligible break per NY week and symbol.
entry: Inside candle has high at or below and low at or above its immediately previous candle, with strictly smaller range. The next completed 12H closes above its high or below its low in the matching V1.7 EMA20/50 direction. The inside bar starts after the full NY Monday clock and signal confirms before that week ends. No Monday 1.618 penetration required. Enter at the exact next H1 open, protective stop at the other side of the inside candle. No restatement based on later breaks.
account: Shared 1000 USDT, nine unlevered slots, unchanged CRC priority, native EMA exit, stop and forced gap/tail execution. OKX taker 5bp per market fill, extra 5bp stress. No historical funding. Compare completed 2025 and 2026 periods separately.
data: Original 291 and 69 independently documented retired contracts, truncated at their delivery times. Use confirmed WAVES native H1 restoration in both rules. Count funded abnormal gap exits and any historic tail settlement as unresolved in this screening.
